Meet The Owner

How DRN Plastering Co Started

DRN Plastering Co began with a commitment to mastering traditional plastering, and has grown into a full surface finishing business: skimming, repairs and media walls alongside Venetian plaster and microcement, for homeowners, interior designers and commercial contractors.

It is run by Darren Denholm, with 15 years in business behind it, from Wishaw. Darren trained in Venetian plaster with Venezia Stucco in Essex and in microcement with Luna Plaster in Coventry, and is an approved installer for Venezia Stucco and Luna Plaster. Everyday plastering is done in gypsum materials, and DRN offers a 12 month guarantee.

[PLACEHOLDER: Darren's own story: how he got into plastering, and what makes DRN different (the form left both blank)]

The aim is simple: a finish that is sound underneath and looks the part, whether it's a repair after a rewire or a Venetian feature wall.

Why Choose Us

What Makes Us Different

  1. 01

    Trained by Venezia Stucco

    Darren trained in Venetian plaster with Venezia Stucco in Essex, one of the first companies to run Venetian plaster training in the UK, and is an approved installer for them. Venetian plaster.

  2. 02

    Approved by Luna Plaster

    His microcement training was with Luna Plaster in Coventry, and Luna has approved him to use their products. Microcement.

  3. 03

    Gypsum Materials, Always

    Day to day plastering is done in gypsum materials, as it always has been: tried and tested by a lot of tradesmen. Plastering and skimming.

  4. 04

    A 12 Month Guarantee

    We offer a 12 month guarantee. Ask what it covers on your job when Darren quotes.

  5. 05

    15 Years in Business

    DRN Plastering Co has 15 years in business behind it, and a 5.0 score from every one of its Google reviews. Read the reviews.

What We Stand For

Our Core Values

Excellence in every layer, from Wishaw to the heart of the Central Belt.

  • The Highest Standards

    Good enough is not the aim. Every wall is treated as if it were in our own home, from the crisp lines of the first coat to the shine of a polished finish.

  • A Clean Site

    The mess is the biggest worry people have about a plasterer. Floors are protected and the workspace is kept tidy, so the only thing left behind is the new surface.

  • Community Roots

    The work takes Darren across Scotland, but DRN is a North Lanarkshire business at heart, and being based in Wishaw keeps it close to local customers.
